notes: backend/internal/server/simple.go:843 - a blank line charges 1 byte to logBudget but adds 0 to log_bytes (the new test asserts this on purpose). The doc line '빈 줄은 1 바이트로 계산' reads as if log_bytes counts it too; harmless in practice because log_bytes is written but never read anywhere (no SELECT, no API field).

backend/internal/server/simple.go:843 - every blank line now issues an extra `UPDATE simple_runs SET log_bytes=log_bytes+0`, a wasted round trip and a dead tuple per blank row. Skipping the UPDATE when len(payload)==0 would be a one-line improvement. Not a blocker: row growth stays the same order as the pre-existing worst case (1-char lines already produced ~4M rows under the same 8 MiB cap).

backend/internal/server/simple.go:844-849 - the recursion claim was verified: take() returns exhausted only when stream != streamSystem, so the notice appended as a system line cannot re-trigger itself. The notice is now dropped if the 64 KiB system reserve is already gone - a behaviour change from the old unconditional INSERT, but consistent with how every other server line is treated.

backend/internal/server/simple.go:788-810 - boundary cases check out: size>0 always yields allowed>=1 (a non-empty line can never be stored as an empty row), exhausted fires exactly once because *remaining<=0 returns early, and payload[:0] is a non-nil empty slice so the BYTEA NOT NULL column gets '' rather than NULL.

backend/internal/server/simple_log_test.go - the unit tests genuinely verify the change: take()'s signature changed, so they cannot compile against the old code, and TestLogBudgetStoresBlankLines/BoundsBlankLines assert the exact new behaviour. simple_logger_test.go:47,75,94 skip without TEST_POSTGRES_DSN; .github/workflows/ci.yml:56 sets it, so they do run in CI. I could not run them locally (no DSN; did not touch the unrelated postgres container on this host).

backend/internal/server/simple_logger_test.go:66 - TestSimpleRunLoggerDoesNotInventATrailingBlankLine would also pass on the pre-fix code. It is a valid guard against the obvious over-correction rather than a test of the fix; the other two logger tests do fail pre-fix.

web/src/pages/simple/SimpleRunDetailPage.tsx:57 - LOG_LINE_HEIGHT is exported but imported nowhere, and no frontend test covers the minHeight. 1.6em against the inherited fontSize 13 does equal the block's line height, so the rendering is right; the export is dead surface.

Scope and revertibility are clean: no migration, no schema change, no dependency change, no auth/secret/deletion path touched. `go vet` and the full `go test ./...` pass, `tsc --noEmit` is clean. A revert restores the old behaviour outright; already-stored empty rows would remain but are harmless.
